snippet.title: Terminal War - Playtest Gameplay
snippet.description:
An early look at an internal playtest. Gameplay is still early & we are continuously testing our systems. We intend to show 4v4 gameplay soon.

Wishlist Now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3788160/Terminal_War/

Terminal War is a grounded, team-based third-person shooter set in a fractured America during the late 1990s. Engage in intense combat across war-torn cities, forgotten towns, and contested territory where every bullet, every strike, and every decision counts.
